validity.zero_spread_interpretation: The declared proxy accepts nonnegative recorded bar spreads. A zero entry spread can only undercharge a LONG entry and a zero exit spread can only undercharge doubled stress; no replacement estimate was introduced. The prelatest gross path, observed executable path and stressed path are all negative, so these optimistic rows cannot manufacture the no-seed conclusion.

supply.structural_role: The exact bundle meets the project-wide three-starts-per-day supply line, so rejection is purely economic rather than a frequency or environment result.

P1_2022H2_2023.interpretation: The initial transfer fails before confirmation: midpoint gross is already negative, both calendar splits lose, every index loses and all five weekdays lose. Cost widens an existing adverse drift rather than erasing a positive one.

P2_2024.interpretation: A negligible positive midpoint drift is much smaller than executable cost. Every symbol is negative after the predeclared stress.

P3_2025.interpretation: The year is negative before cost and on all three symbols after stress; it independently rejects a stable transferred long drift.

P4_2026_JAN_MAY.interpretation: The third confirmation block is again negative at gross, observed and stress and on every symbol.

P5_LATEST_2026_JUN_JUL.interpretation: The latest block passes on all symbols, but its profit is concentrated in June while July is negative. It is the sole positive frozen period and cannot retroactively select a latest-only regime or rescue four failed earlier blocks.

P2_P4_CONFIRMATION.interpretation: All three confirmation blocks are negative, all 9/9 symbol-period cells are negative, and only Friday is positive when weekdays are pooled.

P1_P4_PRELATEST.interpretation: There is no pre-latest latent gross alpha: every symbol is gross-negative and all weekdays are stressed-negative. The path loses 77.09% of starting balance with only 8/46 positive months.

P1_P5_FULL.interpretation: The latest gain lifts midpoint gross only to approximately flat, while observed and stressed paths remain decisively negative. Every symbol and every weekday loses after stress.

temporal_shape.interpretation: The loss is broad rather than one adverse-tail artifact. The top five winning days supply only 10.45% of prelatest positive-day profit, while 38/46 prelatest months and four of four prelatest periods lose.

gate_result.marginal_judgment: Not applicable. The prelatest path is negative before cost, its stressed DD exceeds the practical line by 56.40015 percentage points, all prelatest symbols are gross-negative, and the latest gain does not restore positive full economics.

causal_interpretation.literature_transfer: The exact New York Fed futures-hour sign does not transfer as an unconditional three-CFD economic sleeve across this 2022-2026 FPMarkets surface.
causal_interpretation.cost_role: Cost is material but not the root cause. P1, P3, P4 and pooled P1-P4 are already midpoint-gross negative; full gross is approximately zero. Recorded zero-spread rows make the proxy more favorable, not less.
causal_interpretation.latest_role: June-July 2026 contains a real positive local episode, mostly June. Selecting latest-only, June-only, Tuesday/Thursday, US100-heavy, DST or adjacent-clock treatment would be post-outcome rescue and is forbidden.
causal_interpretation.breadth_role: All three prelatest symbols, all five prelatest weekdays, all three confirmation periods and all nine confirmation symbol-period cells are negative. This is stronger than a marginal gate miss.
causal_interpretation.portfolio_role: A standalone exact bundle with negative gross and stressed economics cannot be integrated, reweighted or risk-sized into the fixed candidate as a rescue.
